title: The powers the module knows: Celerity cast (1.1's way), Potence and Fortitude passive, the Blood commands (Blood Strength, Dexterity, Stamina and Blood Healing)
note: Ours, not the rules package's. By design: Potence and Fortitude passive, free and always on, as Revised has them (the package's source; harm reads them, rules/harm's potence and fortitude blocks, unchanged), Celerity cast as 1.1 casts it, one payment for a time by rank, a press while it is live renews it ('you can implement something now but it'll likely get changed'), (1 + rank)x movement and attack speed by default, 1.1's curve in the data to compare (the module's switch celerity-curve-oneone), instant (no gesture, no busy time). Celerity's attack effect is provisional (multiple attacks under Celerity can be modelled by a single weapon swing): one replaceable piece behind the module's switch celerity-attack-off. Ranks 6 to 10 have no semantics here (gate-29 is open): refused by name. A cast power fills a person's quick slots 1, 2, ... in this file's order. the Blood commands of 1.1's DGRP_Common (game.ndd lines 108-111), cast as 1.1 casts them through the same pipeline: an effect kind each (temp_attribute: a trait raised by an amount by rank for a time, a modifier on the effective value, one a power, a renewal replacing it; heal: Health by rank at once, never past the maximum, refused at full Health), their options the rules package names (common.blood_strength, ...).

powers.label: Celerity
powers.contract: power_verb_contracts.json celerity.active (PAID_DISCRETE_PHYSICAL_ACTIONS): the package's name for the option; its discrete paid actions are not modelled one by one: an earlier build splits Revised's 1 + rank actions into a faster body and blows carried by each swing that lands (the curve split)
powers.cost_source: 1.1's game.ndd line 136 (Celerity): a Blood cost of 30 at every level, in 1.1's units (Blood on 1.1's scale)
powers.recast_source: 1.1's game.ndd line 136 (Celerity): a recast of 1000 ms at every level
powers.beyond: ranks 6 to 10: no cost or time here (1.1's stop at 5; gate-29 open), refused by name (NoSemantics)

split.source: the default: speed plus flurry. By design, something like option c for attacks (one swing standing for several attacks), combined with some speeding up of things so the player can do more, faster. The action economy stays Revised's: A = 1 + rank actions a cycle, these arrays; the exponents split A into a body tempo T = A^exponent (the pace, held in the masquerade as ever; the swing, recovery and block rise) and a flurry K = A / T of blows carried by each real swing that lands on a body (each its own staged harm on that contact), so T x K = A: at 0.5, x1.41 tempo and 1.41 blows at rank 1, x2 and 2 at rank 3, x2.45 and 2.45 at rank 5. A recorded departure from the package's 'no duplicate harm from one contact', by design
split.attack_exponent_source: SANDBOX, by design: half the attack actions (in the logarithm) as a faster swing, half as blows carried by a swing, so neither alone grows past the square root of 1 + rank (rank 10's 11 actions: x3.32 tempo, 3.32 blows a swing)
split.move_exponent_source: SANDBOX, by design (some speeding up of things): the body's pace the same square root of 1 + rank (x1.41 to x2.45 at ranks 1-5), the rest of the movement actions unmodelled; the masquerade still holds a body to the human's pace

one-plus-rank.source: By design: (1 + rank)x movement and attack speed; also Revised's count (rank 5 is six actions a turn) and the engine's pending proposal. the earlier build's default: all tempo, no flurry (T = A, K = 1); an earlier build keeps it under the module's switch celerity-curve-tempo

oneone.source: 1.1's effects.ned line 314 ef_disc_celerity1 (MOVESPEED, MUL) v1-v5 and line 315 ef_disc_celerity2 (ATTACKSPEED, MUL) v1-v5; their v6 (4.0, 1.6) is unreachable. All tempo, no flurry (K = 1)

powers.label: Blood Strength
powers.contract: power_verb_contracts.json common.blood_strength (TEMP_ATTRIBUTE, target self, output attribute.temporary_strength): the package's name for the option
powers.cost_source: 1.1's game.ndd line 109 (BloodStrength, DGRP_Common, type 2 BUFF): a Blood cost of 5 at every level, in 1.1's units
powers.seconds_source: 1.1's Discipline.class BLOODSTRENGTH_DURATIONS: 15000, 30000, 45000, 60000, 90000 ms (its static initializer), read by DisciplineBloodStrength.cast
powers.recast_source: 1.1's game.ndd line 109: a recast of 1000 ms at every level
powers.amount_source: 1.1's effects.ned line 309 ef_disc_bloodstrength (type 3 STAT, subtype 0, compose 5 ADD, flags 0x200 cancellable) v1-v5: +5, +10, +15, +20, +25 in 1.1's attribute points (0 to 100: Christof.NPC lines 23-25); its v6 (+30) is unreachable (levels above 4 are refused)
powers.beyond: ranks 6 to 10: none in 1.1 (levels 0 to 4 only), refused by name (NoSemantics)

raw.source: ours: 1.1's points taken as raw points, as Blood took 1.1's units. The default: on the combat rules' newly Embraced with a sword (raw_to_damage_dice raw/20: Strength 15 is 0.75 dice + 2) +5 is +0.25 dice, about 9 % of the blow's potential a rank, as 1.1's +5 is about 8 % of Christof's random(Strength 30 + BroadSword 30) a rank

proportional.source: ours: the same share of the scale, 1.1's 0..100 to ours 0..1000 (the registry's attribute_domain), so +5 is +50 raw: on the combat rules' newly Embraced +2.5 dice a rank, the blow's potential about doubled at rank 1. To compare (edit the default)

powers.contract: power_verb_contracts.json common.blood_healing (RECOVERY, target self_or_valid_blood_receiver, prerequisites blood_available and recoverable_injury, output health.wound_recovery): the package's name for the option; self only here
powers.cost_source: 1.1's game.ndd line 108 (BloodHealing, DGRP_Common, type 1 HEAL 'when damaged'): a Blood cost of 5 at every level, in 1.1's units
powers.seconds_source: 1.1's DisciplineBloodHealing.cast: AddActorEffectByLevel(ef_disc_bloodhealing, 0, ...): instant (seconds 0; Discipline.class's BLOODHEALING_DURATIONS, 4000 8000 8000 16000 16000 ms, is never read by it)
powers.recast_source: 1.1's game.ndd line 108: a recast of 1000 ms at every level
powers.amount_source: 1.1's effects.ned line 324 ef_disc_bloodhealing (type 9 HI, heal instant, compose 5 ADD) v1-v5: 20, 30, 40, 60, 80 Health of 1.1's 100 (Actor.DefaultHealth; Christof's maximum); on our Health (100 by default) 1:1; never past the maximum (1.1's rpgActor:Heal); refused at full Health (1.1's DisciplineBloodHealing.cancast: RPG_DISC_NOBLOODHEALING); its v6 (100) is unreachable. Not built: 1.1's ranks 3 to 5 also cure poison and disease (ef_curepoison, ef_curedisease), a vampire's heal lowers frenzy
